title: selliguea lungtauensis
intro: Selliguea lungtauensis, commonly known as Lungtau Pilea, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea lungtauensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit potential anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
